articles.title: Lynx’s new broadcaster will stream 25 games free

articles.summary: Pioneer Press, St. Paul, Minn.: Lynx’s new broadcaster will stream 25 games free. With the demise of FanDuel Sports Network, the Lynx have found a new broadcast partner. Victory+, a sports streaming service that produces local broadcasts for the Anaheim Ducks and Texas Ranges, among others, has entered into a partnership with Minnesota’s WNBA team. articles.summary: 24/7 Wall St.: Guggenheim Raises Roku Price Target to $130 as Streaming Households Cross 100 Million: Is the Inflection Real?. Roku (NASDAQ:ROKU) stock picked up a price target raise from Guggenheim on Wednesday, with the firm lifting its target to $130 from $115 while maintaining a Buy rating. articles.title: ThoughtWaves, FBA’s Award-Winning Documentary on the Convergence of Computing, the Internet, and Fiber Optics, Expands Global Distribution
articles.mainIdea: ThoughtWaves, FBA’s Award-Winning Documentary on the Convergence of Computing, the Internet, and Fiber Optics, Expands Global Distribution
articles.summary: Business Wire: ThoughtWaves, FBA’s Award-Winning Documentary on the Convergence of Computing, the Internet, and Fiber Optics, Expands Global Distribution. WASHINGTON, April 22, 2026--The Fiber Broadband Association (FBA) today announced that ThoughtWaves: Connecting Our World — Innovation, Industry & Influence, A Story 50 Years in the Making, a documentary chronicling the parallel rise of the internet and fiber broadband, is now available to global audiences through an expanding slate of streaming platforms.
